contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop and cafe windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The metal guard rail is a scene prop, not a product. Bent forward with one foot on the kerb: the cobalt jacket back and hidden side, the gray crewneck body and the black shorts' seat are conservatively reconstructed. The gray cuffs in the editorial belong to the separate gray inner top; the delivered jacket is corrected v2, with blue cuffs only, and rejected v1 is kept for archive evidence and never deployed. The shorts and full-length tights are separate products. One silver stud is visible; the pair is inferred. Brand, metal, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

deck.ko: 코발트 재킷과 검정 두 겹 하의의 명확한 대비.
deck.en: Cobalt meets two independent black lower layers.

intro.ko: 낮은 턱에 한 발을 올리고 풀린 신발끈을 다시 묶습니다.
intro.en: She raises one foot onto a low curb to retie a loose lace.
intro.de: Sie stellt einen Fuß auf eine niedrige Kante und bindet den gelösten Senkel neu.

body.ko: 코발트 재킷의 흰 위팔 반사선이 플래시에 밝게 보입니다. 회색 긴소매 이너는 재킷 커프 아래 별도 층으로 이어지고 검정 쇼츠와 긴 타이츠가 움직임을 나눕니다. 흰 양말과 메시 러닝화, 검정 원형 시계와 작은 은색 스터드가 손과 발의 동작을 마무리합니다.
body.en: White upper-arm bands on the cobalt jacket catch the flash. Gray inner sleeves remain a separate layer below the blue cuffs, while black shorts and full-length tights divide the lower silhouette. White socks and mesh runners finish the feet; a black round watch and tiny silver-tone studs complete the small details.
body.de: Weiße Oberarmbänder der kobaltblauen Jacke fangen den Blitz. Graue Innenärmel bleiben unter blauen Bündchen eine eigene Lage, schwarze Shorts und lange Tight teilen die untere Silhouette. Weiße Socken und Mesh-Laufschuhe schließen die Füße ab; schwarze Runduhr und kleine Silberstecker ergänzen die Details.
